units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55:1">Gen. R. s. 55</cite>, beg. <he>נ׳ אחר נ׳ גידולין וכ׳</he> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 60:6">Ps. LX, 6</cite>) a repeated elevation, dignity &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a:2">Snh. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>דוד</he> … <he>הביא עצמו לידי נ׳</he> David … placed himself in the power of trial (asked to be tried, <cite ref="Psalms 26:2">Ps. XXVI, 2</cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:3">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>אל תביאני … לידי נ׳</he> suffer me not to come within the power of sin, iniquity, or temptation.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 21:1">Sifré Deut. 21</cite> <he>נותן אתה לי לנ׳</he> wilt thou let me have (the animal) for a trial?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נִסְיוֹנוֹת</he>, <he>נִסְיוֹנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:3">Ab. V, 3</cite> <he>עשרה נ׳ נתנסה וכ׳</he> Abraham underwent ten trials and stood all of them.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 17:2">Num. R. s. 17</cite> <he>נ׳ אחרים</he> additional trials; a. fr.
